summary: The meeting presented proposals for transmitting Scuddy 35 data via an event timeline structure and standardized methods for delivering out-of-band captions (WebVTT/IMSC1) and embedded captions (608/708). Additionally, a scheme was introduced to communicate authentication requirements for tracks using Privacy Pass or Common Access Tokens, while a follow-up discussion addressed the purpose of a logging track for debugging player performance rather than continuous telemetry.
